note: Set A correctly binds the -25.52E+6 watt/rad pitch sensitivity at θ=0º to the NREL 5-MW baseline wind turbine named in the text, and keeps the θ=0º condition. Set B invents a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' entity not present on the page and misattributes both values to it or to 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch' rather than the turbine's pitch sensitivity. However, Set A also errs by labeling 6.302336º as the best-fit line intercept (it is θK, the blade-pitch angle where pitch sensitivity doubles) and includes a vague bare 'θ' claim; Set B likewise treats 6.302336º as a generic angle. Both sets duplicate claims and truncate the unit to 'watt/ra' in one claim, but A's entity bindings are more faithful overall.
